CHAPTER 4 · ITEM 05 / 10

Demand and supply

Market aggregation市場曲線加總

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Add individual quantities horizontally at each price to obtain market demand or market supply.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

在同一價格把各人的數量相加；因數量在橫軸，稱橫向加總。不可把價格相加；當個人選擇零時，不加入負數。

Add individual quantities at the same price. This is horizontal summation because quantity is on the horizontal axis. Do not add prices or include negative supplies or demands when an individual would choose zero.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：At P=$4, A demands 3 units and B demands 5. Market demand is 3+5=8 units. 同價下加總數量。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

At P=$10, three firms supply 2, 0 and 7 units. Market supply? 市場供給量？
